whenToUse: Agencies and partner programmes switching between their own workspace and client or partner portals.
A view-as-client mode that hides internal notes.
avoidWhen: A single workspace product — use shell-01.
Choosing a workspace once after sign-in — use select-workspace-01.
a11y: Each portal region is labelled with aria-labelledby and the active workspace is aria-current; document the ⌘1–5 shortcuts visibly.
